principles: Backups are recovery artifacts, not alternate production stores.
A restore drill must use a disposable isolated target and must never overwrite the source database.
Raw secrets are not normal durable data and must not be copied into application backup evidence.
Backup success is insufficient until restore and integrity verification have retained evidence.
Restore drills have zero external-action authority.

SECRET.handling: Store runtime references only in Operations Core. Secret-provider recovery is governed separately; do not embed secret values in database dumps, logs, test fixtures, evidence or Notion.

n8nPostgresProfile.source: private non-production PostgreSQL backing n8n and Operations Core
n8nPostgresProfile.backupFormat: compressed PostgreSQL dump produced by the approved backup procedure
mustVerify: Run 008 schema/read models are queryable where present
n8n persistent application state is present where included in the source backup
no outbound connectors, schedules or external actions are enabled during drill
no raw credential values are written to evidence
n8nPostgresProfile.encryptionKeyRule: n8n encryption-key recovery must be proven by secure runtime reference/owner procedure; the key itself must not be stored in this contract, repository, Notion evidence or database dump metadata.
